description: The function calls popen() and immediately passes pipe.get() to fgets() without checking whether popen() succeeded. On process-creation failure, resource exhaustion, invalid executable state, or other system error, popen() can return nullptr. The subsequent fgets(..., nullptr) is an invalid dereference and can terminate the collection thread or crash the process, depending on the resulting libc behavior. The function also performs this operation in a loop and can be reached through a start-collection service path, so repeated requests or low-resource conditions can make the failure security-relevant.
